logic.squeeze: 20-bar Bollinger half-width 2.0*population_std(close) is less than 1.5*ATR20 Keltner half-width
logic.release: previous completed bar squeeze=true and current completed bar squeeze=false
logic.direction: long if release close > SMA20 basis; short if release close < SMA20 basis
logic.entry: first executable P75 tick at/after release-bar right edge

selection_rule: advance only a preregistered timeframe that passes supply/economic gates; rank strong survivors by direct net then official wins without retuning
